name: Paul Holmes
headline: Director | Product Go to Market | EMEA
about:
I have been implementing, developing and configuring Netsuite since 2007. During that time I have deployed the platform into a wide range of business sectors, from start-ups to companies with $1bn+ turnover. While my core expertise is Software and Services, most notably as technical consultant on one of the most important global implementations of One World (Misys), I have been exposed to, and have experience with, all modules within the suite. I am an innovator, able to identify business needs and deliver solutions with tangible bottom line impact, be they by system design or re-engineering process.

experiences.position: Director | Product Go to Market | International
Director | Product Go to Market | EMEA

experiences.description:
Reporting to the CIO & VP Digital Business, I have driven an ambitious transformational change agenda through engagement with key internal and external global stakeholders. Selecting, architecting and integrating complex business systems as well as being hands on, directing and mentoring a global team (developers (5), functional specialists (2) and support (6)) to re-engineer and optimize a heavily bespoke CRM/ERP platform.

Key achievements: 
•	Rebuilt the US tax engine to instil compliance rigour: 
o	Scoped/built/tested/master data & inflight transactional cleanse/deployment (all in 6 weeks)
•	Initiated a structured, top-down project prioritization model providing senior management with clear visibility of quarterly deliverables.
•	Project managed numerous deliverables impacting GTM, Operations & Finance within a quarterly format, varying in size from one week to nine-month effort. Of note:
o	Contracts management subscription billing model
o	Lead-to-Order optimization
o	Operational PS model re-build
o	Functional dashboards build/deployment across sales, operations and finance
o	Discount approval model re-build
o	UAT model build to sit comfortably within SOX guidelines
o	Revenue recognition model re-build to ASC606
•	Rebuilt and restructured the in-house NetSuite team resulting in transformational step change
•	Migrated the in-house NetSuite team away from waterfall to agile operating model
•	Instigated an accountability model whereby developers ‘bid’ for their preferred projects each quarter
•	Changed business perception of the platform from ‘frankenmonster’ to ‘slick machine’ 
•	Integrated 3rd party solutions for: 
o	US tax compliance
o	Automated testing
o	Change management 
o	Segregation of duty management
o	Cash application management
•	Collaborated with NetSuite in the design of SuitePeople, subsequently released by NetSuite in 2017.2
•	Now playing a pivotal role in migrating CRM across to SFDC and integrating via Dell Boomi

experiences.position: Netsuite Systems Manager / ISMS Governance Manager
experiences.description:
My Business Systems Manager role was expanded to include responsibility for maintaining compliance of the Information Security Management System to ISO 27001. This was a business critical function as without this certification, continuance as a supplier to the nhs would have been untenable. For this I instigated a number of initiatives; the creation and training of a risk management team across the operational sphere; the creation of a category focused incident management team; the re-engineering of business processes for the management and mitigation of risk; the design and build of an integrated business and clinical risk management workflow application based on ISO/IEC 27000 series standards and the commissioning of an overhaul of business continuity and disaster recovery planning.

Following my achieving both BSi Internal Auditor and Lead Auditor status I conducted operational internal audits to ISO 27001. Where non-conformities were identified, root cause and gap analysis provided the source data to develop corrective action plans and so maintain compliance. The thorough nature and attention to detail I exhibited ensured smooth reviews during the two external audits for which I was responsible.

Post the acquisition of Clinical Solutions by Capita plc I was a key member of the migration process from Netsuite to SAP and formal handover of the ISMS.

In a hands-on capacity I managed the deployment and development of Netsuite OneWorld across global business units, integrating Finance, Sales & Marketing, HR and Project Management. I developed intelligent workflows driving core business and financial procedures to improve process efficiency, data collection and management reporting underpinning business activity and strategy for all global locations.

Key achievements:
•	Built an integrated P&L management tool for projects and R&D activities
•	Drove the improvement of project P&L visibility reducing CONQ by 500k in less than one year
•	Created activity based toolsets for staff to improve effectiveness and systems integration
•	Created a cloud based, task oriented pipeline workflow application
•	Integrated Australia and India into Netsuite to provide Group consolidated accounting

I led a cross-business team to develop the time recording systems, business rules and processes to ensure the cost profile of business activities were understood and thus supported improvement in P&L reporting. Following extensive engagement with all stakeholders I upgraded and re-configured the Journyx timesheet and resource scheduling application. 

After the successful re-launch of Journyx I was retained as a key member of the team tasked with the short listing and selection of a replacement ERP solution. I then led the implementation, configuration, training and development of Netsuite OneWorld Financials; initially into the UK, then the US.

Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer I was responsible for the day-to-day management of centralised EMEA billing and de-centralised credit control functions to satellite units of this global database software company. In addition I instigated and managed various ad-hoc projects on a global scale focusing on process improvement, customer service and business intelligence modelling.

Key functions of the role were:
•	Management of license and support billing cycles across EMEA
•	Ensuring invoicing integrity
•	Management of a credit control team across EMEA
•	Detailed revenue analysis to board level
•	Monthly revenue recognition, capture and reporting to US GAAP
•	Maintenance of database integrity
